table.retrieve:
SELECT  
	TransType = ' Sales',
	InvCode=SL.SaleInvCode,
	CustCode=SL.CustCode,
	Date=SL.Date, 
	Customer=A.Name,
	AliasName=A.AliasName,
	RegNo=C.SalesTaxRegNo,
	GrossAmount = SUM(SD.LooseQty * SD.SalePrice),
	FlatDisc=SUM(SD.LooseQty * SD.ItemFlatDisc),
	ItemDiscount = SUM(SD.LooseQty * (SD.SalePrice - SD.ItemFlatDisc) * (SD.DiscPerc * 0.01) ),
	ClaimValue = SUM(SD.LooseQty * (SD.SalePrice - SD.ItemFlatDisc) * SD.ClaimableDiscPerc * 0.01),
	ClaimDifference = SUM(SD.LooseQty * (SD.SalePrice - SD.ItemFlatDisc) * (SD.DiscPerc * 0.01) ) -
		SUM(SD.LooseQty * (SD.SalePrice - SD.ItemFlatDisc) * SD.ClaimableDiscPerc * 0.01), 
	GSTValue=SUM(SD.LooseQty * (SD.SalePrice - SD.ItemFlatDisc) * (1 - SD.DiscPerc * 0.01) * SD.GSTPerc * 0.01) +
		SUM((SD.LooseQty + SD.BonusQty) * SD.UnitSalesTax),
	NetAmount = SUM(SD.LooseQty * SD.SalePrice) - 
		SUM(SD.LooseQty * SD.ItemFlatDisc) -
		SUM(SD.LooseQty * (SD.SalePrice - SD.ItemFlatDisc) * (SD.DiscPerc * 0.01)) +
		SUM(SD.LooseQty * (SD.SalePrice - SD.ItemFlatDisc) * (1 - SD.DiscPerc * 0.01) * SD.GSTPerc * 0.01) +
		SUM((SD.LooseQty + SD.BonusQty) * SD.UnitSalesTax),
	GSTPERC=MAX(SD.GSTPerc),
	CustomerCategory = (SELECT CC.Name FROM CustomerCategory CC WHERE CC.CustCatCode = C.CustCatCode)
FROM
	SaleLedger SL, SaleDetail SD, Customer C, Accounts A
WHERE
	SL.SaleInvCode = SD.SaleInvCode AND
	SL.Date BETWEEN :ar_Sdate AND :ar_Ldate AND
	SL.CustCode = C.CustCode AND
	C.CustCatCode IN (:ai_custcatcode) AND
	C.CustCode = A.AccCode
GROUP BY
	SL.SaleInvCode,
	SL.CustCode,
	SL.Date,
	C.SalesTaxRegNo,
	A.Name,
	A.AliasName,
	C.CustCatCode
UNION ALL
SELECT 
	TransType = ' Sales',
	InvCode=SL.SaleInvCode,
	CustCode=SL.CustCode,
	Date=SL.Date, 
	Customer=A.Name,
	AliasName=A.AliasName,
	RegNo=C.SalesTaxRegNo,
	GrossAmount = SUM(SD.LooseQty * SD.SalePrice),
	FlatDisc=SUM(SD.LooseQty * SD.ItemFlatDisc),
	ItemDiscount = SUM(SD.LooseQty * (SD.SalePrice - SD.ItemFlatDisc) * (SD.DiscPerc * 0.01) ),
	ClaimValue = SUM(SD.LooseQty * (SD.SalePrice - SD.ItemFlatDisc) * SD.ClaimableDiscPerc * 0.01),
	ClaimDifference = SUM(SD.LooseQty * (SD.SalePrice - SD.ItemFlatDisc) * (SD.DiscPerc * 0.01) ) -
		SUM(SD.LooseQty * (SD.SalePrice - SD.ItemFlatDisc) * SD.ClaimableDiscPerc * 0.01), 
	GSTValue=SUM(SD.LooseQty * (SD.SalePrice - SD.ItemFlatDisc) * (1 - SD.DiscPerc * 0.01) * SD.GSTPerc * 0.01) +
		SUM((SD.LooseQty + SD.BonusQty) * SD.UnitSalesTax),
	NetAmount = SUM(SD.LooseQty * SD.SalePrice) - 
		SUM(SD.LooseQty * SD.ItemFlatDisc) -
		SUM(SD.LooseQty * (SD.SalePrice - SD.ItemFlatDisc) * (SD.DiscPerc * 0.01)) +
		SUM(SD.LooseQty * (SD.SalePrice - SD.ItemFlatDisc) * (1 - SD.DiscPerc * 0.01) * SD.GSTPerc * 0.01) +
		SUM((SD.LooseQty + SD.BonusQty) * SD.UnitSalesTax),
	GSTPERC=MAX(SD.GSTPerc),
	CustomerCategory = (SELECT CC.Name FROM CustomerCategory CC WHERE CC.CustCatCode = C.CustCatCode)
FROM
	SaleLedger SL, SaleInvDetail SD, Customer C, Accounts A
WHERE
	SL.ImpactInventory='N' AND
	SL.SaleInvCode = SD.SaleInvCode AND
	SL.Date BETWEEN :ar_Sdate AND :ar_Ldate AND
	SL.CustCode = C.CustCode AND
	C.CustCatCode IN (:ai_custcatcode) AND
	C.CustCode = A.AccCode
GROUP BY
	SL.SaleInvCode,
	SL.CustCode,
	SL.Date,
	C.SalesTaxRegNo,
	A.Name,
	A.AliasName,
	C.CustCatCode
UNION ALL
SELECT  
	TransType = 'Sales Return',
	InvCode=SL.SRInvCode,
	CustCode=SL.CustCode,
	Date=SL.Date, 
	Customer=A.Name,
	AliasName=A.AliasName,
	RegNo=C.SalesTaxRegNo,
	GrossAmount = SUM(SD.LooseQty * SD.SRPrice),
	FlatDisc=0.00,
	ItemDiscount = SUM(SD.LooseQty * SD.SRPrice * (SD.DiscPerc * 0.01) ),
	ClaimValue = SUM(SD.LooseQty * SD.SRPrice * SD.ClaimableDiscPerc * 0.01),
	ClaimDifference = SUM(SD.LooseQty * SD.SRPrice * (SD.DiscPerc * 0.01) ) -
		SUM(SD.LooseQty * SD.SRPrice * SD.ClaimableDiscPerc * 0.01), 
	GSTValue=SUM(SD.LooseQty * SD.SRPrice * (1 - SD.DiscPerc * 0.01) * SD.GSTPerc * 0.01) +
		SUM((SD.LooseQty + SD.BonusQty) * SD.UnitSalesTax),
	NetAmount = SUM(SD.LooseQty * SD.SRPrice) - 
		SUM(SD.LooseQty * SD.SRPrice * (SD.DiscPerc * 0.01)) +
		SUM(SD.LooseQty * SD.SRPrice * (1 - SD.DiscPerc * 0.01) * SD.GSTPerc * 0.01) +
		SUM((SD.LooseQty + SD.BonusQty) * SD.UnitSalesTax),
	GSTPERC=MAX(SD.GSTPerc),
	CustomerCategory = (SELECT CC.Name FROM CustomerCategory CC WHERE CC.CustCatCode = C.CustCatCode)
FROM
	SRLedger SL, SRDetail SD, Customer C, Accounts A
WHERE
	SL.SaleInvCode IS NULL AND
	SL.SRInvCode = SD.SRInvCode AND
	SL.Date BETWEEN :ar_Sdate AND :ar_Ldate AND
	SL.CustCode = C.CustCode AND
	C.CustCatCode IN (:ai_custcatcode) AND
	C.CustCode = A.AccCode
GROUP BY
	SL.SRInvCode,
	SL.CustCode,
	SL.Date,
	C.SalesTaxRegNo,
	A.Name,
	A.AliasName,
	C.CustCatCode
UNION ALL
SELECT  
	TransType = 'Sales Return',
	InvCode=SL.SRInvCode,
	CustCode=SL.CustCode,
	Date=SL.Date, 
	Customer=A.Name,
	AliasName=A.AliasName,
	RegNo=C.SalesTaxRegNo,
	GrossAmount = SUM(SD.LooseQty * DD.SalePrice),
	FlatDisc=SUM(SD.LooseQty * DD.ItemFlatDisc),
	ItemDiscount = SUM(SD.LooseQty * SD.SRPrice * (SD.DiscPerc * 0.01) ),
	ClaimValue = SUM(SD.LooseQty * SD.SRPrice * SD.ClaimableDiscPerc * 0.01),
	ClaimDifference = SUM(SD.LooseQty * SD.SRPrice * (SD.DiscPerc * 0.01) ) -
		SUM(SD.LooseQty * SD.SRPrice * SD.ClaimableDiscPerc * 0.01), 
	GSTValue=SUM(SD.LooseQty * SD.SRPrice * (1 - SD.DiscPerc * 0.01) * SD.GSTPerc * 0.01) +
		SUM((SD.LooseQty + SD.BonusQty) * SD.UnitSalesTax),
	NetAmount = SUM(SD.LooseQty * SD.SRPrice) - 
		SUM(SD.LooseQty * SD.SRPrice * (SD.DiscPerc * 0.01)) +
		SUM(SD.LooseQty * SD.SRPrice * (1 - SD.DiscPerc * 0.01) * SD.GSTPerc * 0.01) +
		SUM((SD.LooseQty + SD.BonusQty) * SD.UnitSalesTax),
	GSTPERC=MAX(SD.GSTPerc),
	CustomerCategory = (SELECT CC.Name FROM CustomerCategory CC WHERE CC.CustCatCode = C.CustCatCode)
FROM
	SRLedger SL, SRDetail SD, Customer C, Accounts A, SaleDetail DD
WHERE
	SL.SaleInvCode IS NOT NULL AND
	SL.SRInvCode = SD.SRInvCode AND
	SL.Date BETWEEN :ar_Sdate AND :ar_Ldate AND
	SL.CustCode = C.CustCode AND
	C.CustCatCode IN (:ai_custcatcode) AND
	C.CustCode = A.AccCode AND
	SD.SaleRowID = DD.RowID
GROUP BY
	SL.SRInvCode,
	SL.CustCode,
	SL.Date,
	C.SalesTaxRegNo,
	A.Name,
	A.AliasName,
	C.CustCatCode
